title: 2026 NCFlex Dental Plan Details from Benefits Guide (pages 24-26 of 'Benefits Guide 2026', August 2025)
publisher: North Carolina Office of State Human Resources (OSHR) / NCFlex; plan underwritten by Metropolitan Life Insurance Company
document_date_note: Parent guide cover prints 'Benefits Guide 2026' and 'August 2025' (day not printed; 2025-08-01 is a placeholder for the month). OSHR landing page: 'Last Updated: September 2, 2025', 'First Published: September 2, 2025'. The three dental pages themselves do not print a year.

effective_period.quote: Benefits elections made during annual enrollment will begin on January 1 of the following year
effective_period.quote_note: Parent guide p.4 (footer 'www.ncflex.org 4'); cover 'Benefits Guide 2026'. The dental pages (24-26) contain no '2026', 'January' or 'plan year' date; the only date-bearing sentence is 'they must keep that option for the entire plan year' (p.24). End date 2026-12-31 is inferred from the calendar-year structure (certificate: 'Year or Yearly, for Dental Insurance, means the 12 month period that begins January 1.') and the guide title; not printed on the dental pages.

scope.geography: North Carolina (State of North Carolina employees; NCFlex)
scope.population: NCFlex-eligible employees: guide p.2 'An employee may enroll in any or all of the NCFlex benefits if they work for a state agency, university*, participating community college, or participating charter school for 20 hours or more (30 hours or more for the Disability Plan) per week'
scope.plan_type: PPO-type group dental insurance (in- and out-of-network benefits)
scope.network: MetLife Preferred Dental Provider (PDP) Plus Network

retrieval_method: WebFetch (PDF->text; full verbatim transcription of the 3-page extract, then three targeted verification passes; page numbers from printed footers '24 www.ncflex.org', 'www.ncflex.org 25', '26 www.ncflex.org'). Parent 56-page guide fetched separately for plan-year and eligibility sentences.
pages_note: Extract pages are printed 24, 25, 26 (section_page numbering of the parent 56-page guide). The task brief said '2-page'; the PDF has 3 pages.
reuse_terms: not stated for the text. The only copyright line, '© N.C. Department of Natural & Cultural Resources', is the photo credit under the 'Merlefest' image on p.26. North Carolina state government publication (public).
access_limits: WebFetch's answering model limits each quote to ~125 characters; long cells were transcribed in one pass and re-verified in targeted passes. One targeted pass wrongly reported 'plan year' and 'enroll' as NOT PRESENT; a third pass confirmed the full-transcription wording ('entire plan year', 'annual enrollment period'), which is used here.

The dental pages never print the word 'plan pays'; the percentage basis is taken from the footnote wording 'Reimbursement for out-of-network services is based on reasonable and customary (R&C) charge' and 'Benefits are subject to the Maximum Allowable Charge (MAC)', and corroborated by the Classic certificate's 'Covered Percentage' header (see ncflex-metlife-classic-certificate-2020.json).
